protocol: Phase 0 Ground Truth Reveal Protocol v1

steps: 1. Verify all three prediction SHA-256 values against freeze log.
2. Open sealed site mapping for this blinded_site_id.
3. Load Ground Truth from immutable GT artifacts.
4. Compute SHA-256 of Ground Truth record.
6. Compare prediction vs. Ground Truth using predefined metrics.
7. Record results. Do NOT modify predictions.

immutability: Ground Truth data is immutable. If discrepancies are suspected, flag them as GT_DATA_ISSUE — do NOT modify the Ground Truth.
post_reveal_analysis_rule: Any analysis performed AFTER Ground Truth reveal must be labeled POST_REVEAL_ANALYSIS. It must never overwrite or replace the blind prediction. Both analyses coexist.
